title: Banking in Africa
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: In its fifth edition, this report focuses on recent developments in Africa’s banking sectors and the policy options for all stakeholders. The study of banking sectors across all African sub-regions includes the results of the EIB survey of banking groups operating in Africa. Three thematic chapters address challenges and opportunities for financing investment in Africa: Investing sustainably in Africa’s cities; Mobilising agricultural value chain financing in Africa: why and how; Remittances and financial sector development in Africa.
